# 1.21.8 VERSION OUT NOW!
## WELCOME TO HORROR REBORN!
Most - if not all - horror modpacks seem to be based on forge. I decided to fill in for all the people who prefer fabric. This modpack is made with realism, multiplayer support and most obviously horror in mind.

You're always being watched, and knowing this, you'll feel an intense presence upon you. This modpack is the most realistic, horrific experience.
‎ 
## RECOMMENDED SETTINGS
- This modpack is meant to be played with the correct config, do not change ANYTHING.
- It is necessary to use anywhere between **8 to 12 chunk render distance**.
- Multiplayer is supported and is much more fun.
- **Shaders are NOT recommended, V4.0 made the modpack playable without shaders**.

## BUG REPORT
** PLEASE ** report any bugs to @squafy on Discord, friend me, and shoot me the issue!
